Buchu (Barosma betulina)

Remedy urinary infection dysuria bladder anti-inflammatory prostate

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Buchu is a traditional Southern African remedy for urinary tract infections and bladder inflammation. The leaves contain diosphenol and other compounds with antibacterial properties against common UTI pathogens. It has a long history for painful urination and prostate support.

Indications

  • urinary tract infections
  • painful urination (dysuria)
  • bladder inflammation
  • prostate health
  • diuretic
  • antiseptic urinary

Contraindications

  • pregnancy
  • kidney inflammation
  • heparin therapy

Preparations

  • tea
  • capsule
  • tincture

Botanical Information

Botanical Name: Barosma betulina

Family: Rutaceae

Common Names: Buchu, Booku, Dui

Parts Used: leaves

Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Enlarged Prostate (Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia / BPH)
    Enlarged prostate (benign prostatic hyperplasia) is a non-cancerous enlargement of the prostate gland common in older men. Symptoms include difficulty starting urination, weak urine stream, frequent urination, nocturia (waking at night to urinate), and incomplete bladder emptying. It can progress to urinary retention requiring medical intervention.
